description: Official 2019 edition of Irish National Cyber Security Strategy (2019–2024, Mid-Term Review 2023) (Irish National Cyber Security Strategy (2019–2024, Mid-Term Review 2023)), published by National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) & Government of Ireland (ncsc.gov.ie).
relationToCloudSecurity: Defines national cybersecurity, critical infrastructure protection, and digital sovereignty priorities issued by National Cyber Security Centre (NCSC) & Government of Ireland (ncsc.gov.ie) applicable to cloud service providers and operators.
